selection_reason: Only validation survivors audited under whole-share IBKR economics; ordering fixed by lower validation trade concentration, then stress result.

economics.primary_capital_independent_gate: positive gross expectancy, PF >= 1.15 and at least 20 trades
economics.secondary_cost_gate: positive after indicative IBKR tiered costs at USD 1000
economics.stress_diagnostic: fixed USD 1/order plus 10 bps adverse slippage per side

prohibitions: No parameter changes after OOS performance
No candidate substitution after OOS performance
No paper or live authorization from this gate
